title: A finite unramified morphism is etale locally on the base a finite disjoint union of closed immersions
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and unramified [def-weil-unramified-morphism], and let $x\in X$. Then there are an etale morphism $g:U\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $u\in U$ with $g(u)=x$, a finite set $J$ and pairwise disjoint open and closed subschemes $V_j\subseteq Y\times_XU$ ($j\in J$) of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] whose union is $Y\times_XU$, such that for every $j\in J$ the composite $V_j\hookrightarrow Y\times_XU\xrightarrow{\mathrm{pr}_2}U$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. (In general $\kappa(u)\ne\kappa(x)$: $(U,u)$ is an etale neighbourhood, not an elementary one.)

source.place: Stacks Etale Morphisms, Lemma 04HJ (lemma-finite-unramified-etale-local, line 1758); its proof uses Lemma 04HI (lemma-unramified-etale-local-technical), Lemma 04HH (lemma-unramified-etale-local), More on Morphisms Lemma 02LM, Lemma 04DG (lemma-finite-unramified-one-point) and Morphisms Lemma 01W6

proof.text: *The fibre and separatedness.* By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres] (2) the fibre $f^{-1}(\{x\})$ is a finite set; write $f^{-1}(\{x\})=\{y_1,\ldots,y_n\}$ with $n\ge0$ and the $y_i$ distinct. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres] (1) $f$ is separated. Since $f$ is unramified, it is unramified at every $y_i$ in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-etale-local-decomposition] (take the open neighbourhood $Y$ itself).

source.place: Stacks Etale Morphisms, proof of Lemma 04HJ (lemma-finite-unramified-etale-local, line 1758)

proof.text: *Etale localization.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-unramified-etale-local-decomposition] to $f:Y\to X$, $s:=x$ and the points $y_1,\ldots,y_n$ (step 1): there are an etale $g:U\to X$, a point $u\in U$ with $g(u)=x$, and a decomposition $Y_U:=Y\times_XU=W\amalg\coprod_{i=1}^n\coprod_{j=1}^{m_i}V_{i,j}$ into pairwise disjoint open and closed subschemes covering $Y_U$, such that each $V_{i,j}\hookrightarrow Y_U\xrightarrow{\mathrm{pr}_2}U$ is a closed immersion. Since $f^{-1}(\{x\})=\{y_1,\ldots,y_n\}$, the final clause of that lemma says that no point of $W$ lies over $u$: $u\notin\mathrm{pr}_2(W)$.

source.place: Stacks Etale Morphisms, proof of Lemma 04HJ (lemma-finite-unramified-etale-local, line 1758)

proof.text: *The image of $W$ is closed.* The projection $\mathrm{pr}_2:Y_U\to U$ is the base change of the finite morphism $f$ along $g$, hence finite ([lem-weil-pbc-finite-morphism-permanence] (a)), hence a closed map ([lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres] (1)). $W$ is closed in $Y_U$ (its complement $\bigcup_{i,j}V_{i,j}$ is open), so $Z:=\mathrm{pr}_2(W)$ is a closed subset of $U$, and $u\notin Z$ by step 2.

source.place: Stacks Etale Morphisms, proof of Lemma 04HJ (lemma-finite-unramified-etale-local, line 1758)

proof.text: *Shrinking $U$.* Let $U'=U\setminus Z$, an open subset containing $u$ (step 3), with its open subscheme structure and inclusion $\iota:U'\to U$, an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Then $\iota$ is etale and $g'=g\circ\iota:U'\to X$ is etale ([lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (1), (2)), with $g'(u)=x$. Put $Y'=\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}(U')\subseteq Y_U$, an open subscheme. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] (for $\mathrm{pr}_2:Y_U\to U$ and $\iota$ over $U$, with the opens $Y_U$, $U'$, $U$) the fibre product $Y_U\times_UU'$ is identified with $Y'$, the second projection being $\mathrm{pr}_2|_{Y'}:Y'\to U'$; by the universal property of fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] (pasting: a pair $a:T\to Y$, $b:T\to U'$ with $f\circ a=g'\circ b$ is the same as a morphism $(a,\iota\circ b):T\to Y_U$ together with $b$, compatible over $U$), $Y_U\times_UU'=Y\times_XU'$. Hence $Y\times_XU'=Y'$ with second projection $\mathrm{pr}_2|_{Y'}$.

source.place: Stacks Etale Morphisms, proof of Lemma 04HJ (lemma-finite-unramified-etale-local, line 1758)

proof.text: *The decomposition over $U'$.* Since $\mathrm{pr}_2(W)=Z$ is disjoint from $U'$, $W\cap Y'=\emptyset$. Let $J=\{(i,j):1\le i\le n,1\le j\le m_i\}$, a finite set, and for $(i,j)\in J$ put $V'_{i,j}=V_{i,j}\cap Y'$, an open and closed subscheme of $Y'$; the $V'_{i,j}$ are pairwise disjoint and cover $Y'=Y\times_XU'$, because $W,V_{i,j}$ do so in $Y_U$ and $W\cap Y'=\emptyset$. Writing $p_{i,j}:V_{i,j}\to U$ for the closed immersion of step 2, $V'_{i,j}=p_{i,j}^{-1}(U')$ and, by [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] (for $p_{i,j}$ and $\iota$ over $U$), $V'_{i,j}$ with $p_{i,j}|_{V'_{i,j}}:V'_{i,j}\to U'$ is the fibre product $V_{i,j}\times_UU'$ with its second projection. By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change] this projection is a closed immersion, and it is the composite $V'_{i,j}\hookrightarrow Y\times_XU'\xrightarrow{\mathrm{pr}_2}U'$. So $(g',u,J,(V'_{i,j})_{(i,j)\in J})$ is as claimed. (If $n=0$ then $J=\emptyset$ and $Y\times_XU'=\emptyset$, which is allowed.)

split_report.summary: Statement corrected: the clause kappa(x) = kappa(u) is not in Stacks 04HJ (which gives only an etale neighbourhood; its proof goes through 04HI/04HH/02LM, and 02LM uses a Galois extension of kappa(s)) and is false: for Y = Spec C -> X = Spec R (finite etale) any etale (U,u) with kappa(u) = R has the point of Y_U over u with residue field C, so the piece through it cannot be a closed immersion into U; dropped it with def-weil-residue-field from stmt_deps (the only citer, lem-weil-pbc-finite-etale-etale-local-split, states it does not use that clause). Proof in five steps following 04HJ: finite fibre and separatedness (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres), 04HI (new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-unramified-etale-local-decomposition) giving Y_U = W + coprod V_ij with no point of W over u, closedness of pr_2(W) (finite base change, existing leaf; finite => closed map), shrinking U to U minus pr_2(W) with the open fibre product identification written out, and the closed immersions over U' by base change. lean.statement: theorem exists_etale_closed_immersion_decomposition_of_finite_unramified {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsOpenImmersion (pullback.diagonal f)] (x : X) : ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ X) (u : U), Etale g ∧ g.base u = x ∧ ∃ (J : Type u) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ j, V j ⟶ pullback f g), Finite J ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback f g) ι)) ∧ (∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (ι j) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (ι j)) ∧ (∀ j, IsClosedImmersion (ι j ≫ pullback.snd f g))
